scope: Four previously inspected development transactions, each with a fresh same-pixel control and a candidate differing only by a general prompt clarification. Three one-photo canonical cases cover a long quantity receipt, grouped amounts/payments and reduced-price rows; the two-photo UK compact case guards coupons and VAT. No annotations, OCR, location or currency context enters either model request.
promotion_gate: Require improved source-known line-price accuracy with no regressions in known purchase names/counts, quantities, unit prices, discounts, tax/fees/rounding or copied totals across these pairs. Inspect unsupported changes and retained review gates. A successful pilot alone does not certify a new full-cohort or public-ready reader.
limits: Four already inspected development transactions, not a blind holdout or the full fifty. The context view supplies currency only after extraction. Unknown/faint fields remain excluded; copied totals do not establish calculated financial correctness. Frozen real verifier/calculator uses the same independent saved OCR for each pair. CLI times include model load/encoding/generation, exclude preparation/setup/validation and have cache/order/host effects; no speed ratio, p95 or handset claim. Process working set excludes GPU/browser/backend. No receipt values or source checks were repaired.
